dedupe_keys.name: ics nad network attack detection dataset from multiple real world industrial control systems

description: ICS-NAD is a network attack detection dataset collected in real-world industrial control system scenarios using equipment from three well-known ICS brands. The Science Data Bank record says it covers 20 common ICS attack types in two attack traffic patterns, and gives raw ICS network traffic as PCAP with 60 extracted and fully labelled features as CSV, validated with 10 machine learning and deep learning classifiers. It was issued in August 2025 (version V1) by five authors as 272 files of about 264 GB in total (the description says 245.96 GB of data files), free under CC0. Coverage is the systems of the three brands used in the study. Caveats: the brands, sites and protocols are not named in the record read, the author affiliations are not stated on the page read, and the full download is very large. For simulation it gives labelled real-controller attack traffic to train and benchmark intrusion detection, and to set detection rates in models of cyber attacks on industrial plants. Related catalogue records include the ICS-ADD smart industry testbed data and the ICS SCADA cyber kit testbed traffic.
